title: lycopodiella inundata
intro: Lycopodiella inundata, commonly known as the floating club moss, is a type of small, perennial plant that belongs to the club moss family. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodiella inundata include its use as a diuretic, which helps to alleviate water retention, and its ability to stimulate circulation and improve cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
